verdict.rationale: Google Drive itself has no native rules engine for user-defined triggers/actions, but its API exposes push notifications (watch changes) and the Changes resource that third-party tools (e.g., Apps Script, Zapier) can use to build automation. This shows event-detection primitives rather than a built-in rule-authoring UI for end users. missing for 10: a native no-code rule/trigger builder in Drive itself, documented end-to-end automation examples, and independent confirmation of reliability of these triggers.
